title: Duties Act 2001
why: Transfer (stamp) duty rates on buying a home; the first home buyer duty concession (Ch 2 Pt 5 Div 2A), pensioner duty concession (Div 2B) and pre-completion concession (Div 2C); the first home buyer duty exemption (Ch 2 Pt 6 Div 2); and motor vehicle duty (Ch 8).
